SCREEN.TITLE: Speech audiometry
SCREEN.WARNING_LEVEL: Approximate level: loudspeaker presentation is not clinically calibrated. The robust outcome is the discrimination % at conversational level. Binaural (best-ear) result: does not rule out a unilateral loss.
SCREEN.PICK_IMAGE: What did you hear? Touch its picture
SCREEN.PICK_WORD: Which word did you hear? Touch its card
SCREEN.CARDS_LOCKED_HINT: Press “Play word” to enable the cards
SCREEN.COMPLETED_TEXT: You can repeat the list at another level (per-level results are kept) or save the result.
SCREEN.ASSISTANT_COMPLETED: List completed at {{level}} dB. You can repeat the list at another level or save the result.
SCREEN.ASSISTANT_PRACTICE: Practice card (not scored): teach the task to the patient before starting the test.
SCREEN.ASSISTANT_PRESENT: Press “Play word” to present the stimulus at {{level}} dB ({{levelLabel}}). Cards are enabled after the presentation.
SCREEN.ASSISTANT_WAITING: The patient must touch the card of the word heard. {{remaining}} help repetitions left.
SCREEN.DISCLAIMER: Approximate on-device measure. It does not replace certified equipment nor constitute a diagnosis.
SCREEN.TOAST_NO_EVALUATION_TEXT: There is no active evaluation associated with the patient.
SCREEN.TOAST_ERROR_TEXT: The speech audiometry could not be recorded. Please try again.

RESULT.NO_DATA: Speech audiometry: not enough responses to assess discrimination
RESULT.SUMMARY: Sound-field speech audiometry ({{band}}): discrimination {{pct}} % ({{correct}}/{{presented}}) at {{level}} dB ({{levelLabel}}) — {{status}}
RESULT.REFERRAL: Given signs of word-recognition difficulty, referral to a specialized centre (ENT/audiology) for diagnostic speech audiometry is recommended.
RESULT.DISCLAIMER: Closed-set, binaural sound-field test at an approximate level: it estimates the better ear and does not rule out a unilateral loss.
